title: Registry library: personas, flags, intents, who may open what
why_model: Pure functions over a JSON table with an explicit expectation table and a rule written out in full. The access test is table-driven, so there is no judgement left.
notes: registry.json is copied byte for byte from docs/design/workspaces/registry.json. WS-REG-T05 imports canAccess from lib/auth/access and must pass without editing it.

title: Dialog renderer: templates, variants, chips, counts line
why_model: A tiny template language with a reference implementation (docs/design/workspaces/check.py) and 27 worked examples; the test is a loop over the examples.
notes: Run `python docs/design/workspaces/check.py` first and read its dialog section: it is the reference the TypeScript must match. dialog.json is copied byte for byte.

title: URL state: parse and build workspace links, with no patient criteria
why_model: Every output is given as an exact string in the spec; the privacy rule is an assertion on the output.
notes: Uses intentById and the intent's route and kind from WSP-01. Never reads or writes age, postcode, need or when.

title: WorkspaceFrame: top bar, thread slot, canvas, footer; no side rail
why_model: Presentational, props and markup given in full, copies the role-chip logic from the existing TopBar.
gaps: The page shell must be 100vh with no page scroll at 1440 by 900; the canvas fills the space between the top bar and the footer. Verify in the Playwright run, not in jsdom.
notes: Read components/shell/TopBar.tsx and copy its role-chip logic; do not import or edit it.

title: ThreadDrawer and AssistantButton
why_model: Presentational with a fixed DOM order and exact names. The live-region rule is stated as a test.
notes: Exports ThreadMessage, ThreadChip and ThreadSummary types used by WSP-08.

title: TriageCard: age and postcode, then need and timeframe
why_model: Controlled chips over the existing AGE_BANDS, NEEDS and URGENCIES lists. All state is the parent's.
notes: Does not render the postcode field: the parent passes it as postcodeSlot.

title: CriteriaSummary widget
why_model: A four-row description list with a shape and a word for unset.

title: WorkspaceProvider: criteria in memory, thread history, hidden flag
why_model: The one stateful core: history that updates in place, a privacy rule (criteria never stored or put in a URL), storage through the guarded helper, and a role-based filter on chips. Haiku writes the tests from the case list; Sonnet implements against the red tests.
notes: Use tenantStore only. A raw localStorage or sessionStorage call fails the repository guards. A different Sonnet session verifies; the verifier also reads the privacy cases as the acceptance test.

title: WorkspaceShell, WorkspacePage and the advisor-v2 layout
why_model: Reads the signed-in session and the tenant profile on the server and decides what the layout shows; a mistake here shows the wrong person's role or organisation.
gaps: Replacing StaffShell for this route group removes the rail from Capacity and Services as well; WS-RTE gives those pages the new frame.
notes: Read app/StaffShell.tsx first; WorkspaceShell is the same reads without the rail. Test files named in `add` are listed with the layout test; the two component tests are in `tests`.

title: AdvisorWorkspace: intake in the thread, results on the canvas
why_model: Composes the router, a debounced search, the existing postcode picker and grouped results, and enforces the privacy rule end to end. Haiku writes the tests with msw and mocked navigation; Sonnet builds.
gaps: The page number inside a PagedGrid is not in the URL, so Back returns to page 1 of the same list. The map and not-suitable views are not live (registry phase 4).
notes: Copy the postcode lookup and the group and tile rendering from FindService.tsx; do not edit it and do not import from it. Import PagedGrid and ServiceTile from parts.tsx.

title: Service detail inside the workspace
why_model: A thin wrapper around an existing component with the provider and page APIs fixed by the units it depends on.
gaps: ServiceDetail draws its own back link and breadcrumb as well as the frame's Back. Both go to the same place. Removing one needs a ServiceDetail change, which is not in this unit.
notes: Read the existing page.test.tsx and keep its intent.

title: Capacity and Services pages in the new frame; find mode switches over
why_model: Two small server pages re-wrapped in an existing component; the cases name every expected element.
notes: Read each page and its existing test first. After this unit FindService is no longer used by a page; deleting it is a separate cleanup.

title: Overview workspace on /analytics (outline: refine the cases before building)
why_model: The spec is an outline: the builder must read AnalyticsOverview and its drill code and refine the cases first. Not eligible for Haiku until the cases are exact. The aggregate-only rule is a safety property.
gaps: Spec depth: outline. Refine WS-OVW-T01 to T05 into exact assertions before writing code, and report the refined list.
notes: Phase 2. Start after WSP-10 has been verified, so the patterns are settled.
